verses.en: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:
verses.pt: Vinda a manhã, todos os chefes dos sacerdotes e anciãos do povo juntamente se aconselharam contra Jesus, para o matarem.
verses.en_web: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:
verses.en_bbe: Now when it was morning, all the chief priests and those in authority took thought together with the purpose of putting Jesus to death.

verses.en: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
verses.pt: E o levaram amarrado, e o entregaram a Pôncio Pilatos, o governador.
verses.en_web: and they bound him, and led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.
verses.en_bbe: And they put cords on him and took him away, and gave him up to Pilate, the ruler.

verses.en: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
verses.pt: Então Judas, o que o havia traído, ao ver que Jesus já estava condenado, devolveu, sentindo remorso, as trinta moedas de prata aos chefes dos sacerdotes e aos anciãos;
verses.en_web: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
verses.en_bbe: Then Judas, who was false to him, seeing that he was to be put to death, in his regret took back the thirty bits of silver to the chief priests and those in authority,

verses.en: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see thou to that.
verses.pt: e disse: Pequei, traindo sangue inocente. Porém eles disseram: Que nos interessa? Isso é problema teu!
verses.en_web: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”
verses.en_bbe: Saying, I have done wrong in giving into your hands an upright man. But they said, What is that to us? it is your business.

verses.en: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.
verses.pt: Então ele lançou as moedas de prata no templo, saiu, e foi enforcar-se.
verses.en_web: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary, and departed. He went away and hanged himself.
verses.en_bbe: And he put down the silver in the Temple and went out, and put himself to death by hanging.

verses.en: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.
verses.pt: Os chefes dos sacerdotes tomaram as moedas de prata, e disseram: Não é lícito pô-las no tesouro das ofertas, pois isto é preço de sangue.
verses.en_web: The chief priests took the pieces of silver, and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”
verses.en_bbe: And the chief priests took the silver and said, It is not right to put it in the Temple store for it is the price of blood.

verses.en: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter’s field, to bury strangers in.
verses.pt: Então juntamente se aconselharam, e compraram com elas o campo do oleiro, para ser cemitério dos estrangeiros.
verses.en_web: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them, to bury strangers in.
verses.en_bbe: And they made a decision to get with the silver the potter's field, as a place for the dead of other countries.

verses.en: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.
verses.pt: Por isso aquele campo tem sido chamado campo de sangue até hoje.
verses.en_web: Therefore that field was called “The Field of Blood” to this day.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause that field was named, The field of blood, to this day.

verses.en: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;
verses.pt: Assim se cumpriu o que foi dito pelo profeta Jeremias, que disse: Tomaram as trinta moedas de prata, preço avaliado pelos filhos de Israel, o qual eles avaliaram;
verses.en_web: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him upon whom a price had been set, whom some of the children of Israel priced,
verses.en_bbe: Then came true that which was said by Jeremiah the prophet, And they took the thirty bits of silver, the price of him who was valued by the children of Israel;

verses.en: And gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord appointed me.
verses.pt: e as deram pelo campo do oleiro, conforme o que o Senhor me mandou. Zacarias 11:12-13; Jeremias 19:1-13; 32:6-9
verses.en_web: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”
verses.en_bbe: And they gave them for the potter's field, as I had word from the Lord.

verses.en: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.
verses.pt: Jesus esteve diante do governador, e o governador lhe perguntou: És tu o Rei dos Judeus? E Jesus lhe respondeu: Tu o dizes.
verses.en_web: Now Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus said to him, “So you say.”
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus was before the ruler, who put a question to him, Are you the King of the Jews? And Jesus said to him, You say so.

verses.en: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
verses.pt: E, sendo ele foi acusado pelos chefes dos sacerdotes e pelos anciãos, nada respondeu.
verses.en_web: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
verses.en_bbe: But when the chief priests and those in authority made statements against him, he gave no answer.

verses.en: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?
verses.pt: Pilatos, então, lhe disse: Não ouves quantas coisas estão testemunhando contra ti?
verses.en_web: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”
verses.en_bbe: Then says Pilate to him, Do you give no attention to what their witnesses say against you?

verses.en: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
verses.pt: Mas Jesus não lhe respondeu uma só palavra, de maneira que o governador ficou muito maravilhado.
verses.en_web: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.
verses.en_bbe: And he gave him no answer, not even a word: so that the ruler was greatly surprised.

verses.en: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.
verses.pt: Na festa o governador costuma soltar um preso ao povo, qualquer um que quisessem.
verses.en_web: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner, whom they desired.
verses.en_bbe: Now at the feast it was the way for the ruler to let free to the people one prisoner, at their selection.

verses.en: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
verses.pt: E tinham então um preso bem conhecido, chamado Barrabás.
verses.en_web: They had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
verses.en_bbe: And they had then an important prisoner, whose name was Barabbas.

verses.en: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?
verses.pt: Quando, pois, se ajuntaram, Pilatos lhes perguntou: Qual quereis que vos solte? Barrabás, ou Jesus, que é chamado Cristo?
verses.en_web: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus, who is called Christ?”
verses.en_bbe: So when they came together, Pilate said to them, Whom will you have? Barabbas, or Jesus, who is named Christ?

verses.en: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.
verses.pt: Pois ele sabia que foi por inveja que o entregaram.
verses.en_web: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.
verses.en_bbe: For he saw that for envy they had given him up.

verses.en: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.
verses.pt: E, enquanto ele estava sentado no assento de juiz, sua mulher lhe enviou a seguinte mensagem: Nada faças com aquele justo, pois hoje sofri muito em sonhos por causa dele.
verses.en_web: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”
verses.en_bbe: And while he was on the judge's seat, his wife sent to him, saying, Have nothing to do with that upright man, for I have had much trouble this day in a dream because of him.

verses.en: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
verses.pt: Mas os chefes dos sacerdotes e os anciãos persuadiram as multidões a pedirem Barrabás, e a exigirem a morte de Jesus.
verses.en_web: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: Now the chief priests and those in authority got the people to make request for Barabbas, and for Jesus to be put to death.

verses.en: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.
verses.pt: O governador lhes perguntou: Qual destes dois quereis que vos solte? E responderam: Barrabás!
verses.en_web: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”
verses.en_bbe: But the ruler made answer and said to them, Which of the two is it your pleasure that I let go free? And they said, Barabbas.

verses.en: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.
verses.pt: Pilatos lhes disse: Que, pois, farei de Jesus, que é chamado Cristo? Todos lhe disseram: Seja crucificado!
verses.en_web: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus, who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”
verses.en_bbe: Pilate says to them, What, then, am I to do with Jesus, who is named Christ? They all say, Let him be put to death on the cross.

verses.en: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.
verses.pt: E o governador perguntou: Ora, que mal ele fez? Porém gritavam mais: Seja crucificado!
verses.en_web: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Why, what evil has he done? But they gave loud cries, saying, To the cross with him!

verses.en: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.
verses.pt: Quando, pois, Pilatos viu que nada adiantava, em vez disso se fazia mais tumulto, ele pegou água, lavou as mãos diante da multidão, e disse: Estou inocente do sangue deste justo. A responsabilidade é vossa.
verses.en_web: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”
verses.en_bbe: So when Pilate saw that he was able to do nothing, but that trouble was working up, he took water and, washing his hands before the people, said, The blood of this upright man is not on my hands: you are responsible.

verses.en: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.
verses.pt: E todo o povo respondeu: O sangue dele venha sobre nós, e sobre os nossos filhos.
verses.en_web: All the people answered, “May his blood be on us, and on our children!”
verses.en_bbe: And all the people made answer and said, Let his blood be on us, and on our children.

verses.en: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.
verses.pt: Então soltou-lhes Barrabás, enquanto que mandou açoitar Jesus, e o entregou para ser crucificado.
verses.en_web: Then he released to them Barabbas, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.
verses.en_bbe: Then he let Barabbas go free: but after having Jesus whipped, he gave him up to be put to death on the cross.

verses.en: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers.
verses.pt: Em seguida, os soldados do governador levaram Jesus consigo ao pretório, ajuntaram-se a ele toda a unidade miltar.
verses.en_web: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.
verses.en_bbe: Then the ruler's armed men took Jesus into the open square, and got all their band together.

verses.en: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
verses.pt: Eles o despiram e o cobriram com um manto vermelho.
verses.en_web: They stripped him, and put a scarlet robe on him.
verses.en_bbe: And they took off his clothing, and put on him a red robe.

verses.en: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!
verses.pt: E, depois de tecerem uma coroa de espinhos, puseram-na sobre a sua cabeça, e uma cana em sua mão direita. Em seguida, puseram-se de joelhos diante dele, zombando-o, e diziam: Felicitações, Rei dos Judeus!
verses.en_web: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him, and mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
verses.en_bbe: And they made a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and put a rod in his right hand, and they went down on their knees before him, and made sport of him, saying, Long life to the King of the Jews.

verses.en: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.
verses.pt: E cuspiram nele, tomaram a cana, e deram-lhe golpes na cabeça.
verses.en_web: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.
verses.en_bbe: And they put shame on him, and gave him blows on the head with the rod.

verses.en: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.
verses.pt: Depois de terem o zombado, despiram-lhe a capa, vestiram-no com suas roupas, e o levaram para crucificar.
verses.en_web: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.
verses.en_bbe: And when they had made sport of him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothing on him, and took him away to put him on the cross.

verses.en: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.
verses.pt: Ao saírem, encontraram um homem de Cirene, por nome Simão; e obrigaram-no a levar sua cruz.
verses.en_web: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.
verses.en_bbe: And while they were coming out, they saw a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they made him go with them, so that he might take up his cross.

verses.en: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,
verses.pt: E quando chegaram ao lugar chamado Gólgota, que significa “o lugar da caveira”,
verses.en_web: When they came to a place called “Golgotha”, that is to say, “The place of a skull,”
verses.en_bbe: And when they came to the place named Golgotha, that is to say, Dead Man's Head,

verses.en: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.
verses.pt: deram-lhe de beber vinagre misturado com fel. E, depois de provar, não quis beber.
verses.en_web: they gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall. When he had tasted it, he would not drink.
verses.en_bbe: They gave him wine mixed with bitter drink: and after tasting it, he took no more.

verses.en: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.
verses.pt: E havendo-o crucificado, repartiram suas roupas, lançando sortes; para que se cumprisse o que foi dito pelo profeta: Repartiram entre si minhas roupas, e sobre minha túnica lançaram sortes.
verses.en_web: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots,
verses.en_bbe: And when they had put him on the cross, they made division of his clothing among them by the decision of chance.

verses.en: And sitting down they watched him there;
verses.pt: Então se sentaram, e ali o vigiavam.
verses.en_web: and they sat and watched him there.
verses.en_bbe: And they were seated there watching him.

verses.en: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.pt: E puseram, por cima de sua cabeça, sua acusação escrita: ESTE É JESUS, O REI DOS JUDEUS.
verses.en_web: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, “THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
verses.en_bbe: And they put up over his head the statement of his crime in writing, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

verses.en: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.
verses.pt: Então foram crucificados com ele dois criminosos, um à direita, e outro à esquerda.
verses.en_web: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.
verses.en_bbe: Then two thieves were put on crosses with him, one on the right and one on the left.

verses.en: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,
verses.pt: Os que passavam blasfemavam dele, balançando suas cabeças,
verses.en_web: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads,
verses.en_bbe: And those who went by said bitter words to him, shaking their heads and saying,

verses.en: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.
verses.pt: e dizendo: Tu, que derrubas o Templo, e em três dias o reconstróis, salva a ti mesmo! Se és Filho de Deus, desce da cruz.
verses.en_web: and saying, “You who destroy the temple, and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”
verses.en_bbe: You who would give the Temple to destruction and put it up again in three days, get yourself free: if you are the Son of God, come down from the cross.

verses.en: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him, with the scribes and elders, said,
verses.pt: E da mesma maneira também os chefes dos sacerdotes, com os escribas e os anciãos, escarnecendo dele,diziam:
verses.en_web: Likewise the chief priests also mocking, with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,
verses.en_bbe: In the same way, the chief priests, making sport of him, with the scribes and those in authority, said,

verses.en: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.
verses.pt: Salvou outros, a si mesmo não pode salvar. Se é Rei de Israel, desça agora da cruz, e creremos nele.
verses.en_web: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.
verses.en_bbe: A saviour of others, he has no salvation for himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will have faith in him.

verses.en: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.
verses.pt: Confiou em Deus, livre-o agora, se lhe quer bem; pois disse: “Sou Filho de Deus”.
verses.en_web: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”
verses.en_bbe: He put his faith in God; let God be his saviour now, if he will have him; for he said, I am the Son of God.

verses.en: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.
verses.pt: E os ladrões que estavam crucificados com ele também lhe insultavam.
verses.en_web: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.
verses.en_bbe: And the thieves who were on the crosses said evil words to him.

verses.en: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.
verses.pt: Desde a hora sexta houve trevas sobre toda a terra até a hora nona.
verses.en_web: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.
verses.en_bbe: Now from the sixth hour it was dark over all the land till the ninth hour.

verses.en: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
verses.pt: E perto da hora nona, Jesus gritou em alta voz: Eli, Eli, lamá sabactâni?, Isto é: Deus meu, Deus meu, porque me desamparaste?
verses.en_web: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”
verses.en_bbe: And about the ninth hour Jesus gave a loud cry, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is, My God, my God, why are you turned away from me?

verses.en: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.
verses.pt: E alguns dos que ali estavam, quando ouviram, disseram: Ele está chamando Elias.
verses.en_web: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”
verses.en_bbe: And some of those who were near by, hearing it, said, This man is crying to Elijah.

verses.en: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.
verses.pt: Logo um deles correu e tomou uma esponja. Então a encheu de vinagre, colocou-a em uma cana, e lhe dava de beber.
verses.en_web: Immediately one of them ran, and took a sponge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.
verses.en_bbe: And straight away one of them went quickly, and took a sponge, and made it full of bitter wine, and put it on a rod and gave him drink.

verses.en: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.
verses.pt: Porém os outros disseram: Deixa, vejamos se Elias vem livrá-lo.
verses.en_web: The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”
verses.en_bbe: And the rest said, Let him be; let us see if Elijah will come to his help.

verses.en: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.
verses.pt: Jesus gritou outra vez em alta voz, e entregou o espírito.
verses.en_web: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus gave another loud cry, and gave up his spirit.

verses.en: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;
verses.pt: E eis que o véu do Templo se rasgou em dois, de cima até embaixo, a terra tremeu, e as pedras se fenderam.
verses.en_web: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.
verses.en_bbe: And the curtain of the Temple was parted in two from end to end; and there was an earth-shock; and the rocks were broken;

verses.en: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,
verses.pt: Os sepulcros se abriram, e muitos corpos de santos que tinham morrido foram ressuscitados.
verses.en_web: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;
verses.en_bbe: And the resting-places of the dead came open; and the bodies of a number of sleeping saints came to life;

verses.en: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.
verses.pt: E, depois de ressuscitarem, saíram dos sepulcros, vieram à santa cidade, e apareceram a muitos.
verses.en_web: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.
verses.en_bbe: And coming out of their resting-places, after he had come again from the dead, they went into the holy town and were seen by a number of people.

verses.en: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.
verses.pt: E o centurião, e os que com ele vigiavam Jesus, ao verem o terremoto e as coisas que haviam sucedido, tiveram muito medo, e disseram: Verdadeiramente ele era Filho de Deus.
verses.en_web: Now the centurion, and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake, and the things that were done, feared exceedingly, saying, “Truly this was the Son of God.”
verses.en_bbe: Now the captain and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earth-shock and the things which were done, were in great fear and said, Truly this was a son of God.

verses.en: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:
verses.pt: Muitas mulheres, que desde a Galileia haviam seguido Jesus, e o serviam, estavam ali, olhando de longe.
verses.en_web: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.
verses.en_bbe: And a number of women were there, watching from a distance, who had come with Jesus from Galilee, waiting on his needs.

verses.en: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee’s children.
verses.pt: Entre elas estavam Maria Madalena, e Maria mãe de Tiago e de José, e a mãe dos filhos de Zebedeu.
verses.en_web: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.
verses.en_bbe: Among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary, the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

verses.en: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus’ disciple:
verses.pt: E chegado o entardecer, veio um homem rico de Arimateia, por nome José, que também era discípulo de Jesus.
verses.en_web: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea, named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple came.
verses.en_bbe: And in the evening, there came a man of wealth from Arimathaea, Joseph by name, who was a disciple of Jesus:

verses.en: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.
verses.pt: Ele chegou a Pilatos, e pediu o corpo de Jesus. Então Pilatos mandou que o corpo lhe fosse entregue.
verses.en_web: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.
verses.en_bbe: This man went in to Pilate, and made a request for the body of Jesus. Then Pilate gave orders for it to be given to him.

verses.en: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
verses.pt: José tomou o corpo, e o envolveu em um lençol limpo, de linho fino,
verses.en_web: Joseph took the body, and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
verses.en_bbe: And Joseph took the body, folding it in clean linen,

verses.en: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.
verses.pt: e o pôs em seu sepulcro novo, que tinha escavado numa rocha; em seguida rolou uma grande pedra à porta do sepulcro, e foi embora.
verses.en_web: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock, and he rolled a great stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.
verses.en_bbe: And put it in the resting-place which had been cut out of the rock for himself; and after rolling a great stone to the door of it he went away.

verses.en: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.
verses.pt: E ali estavam Maria Madalena e a outra Maria, sentadas de frente ao sepulcro.
verses.en_web: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.
verses.en_bbe: And Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, seated by the place of the dead.

verses.en: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,
verses.pt: No dia seguinte, que é o depois da preparação, os chefes dos sacerdotes, e os fariseus se reuniram com Pilatos,
verses.en_web: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,
verses.en_bbe: Now on the day after the getting ready of the Passover, the chief priests and Pharisees came together to Pilate,

verses.en: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.
verses.pt: e disseram: Senhor, nos lembramos que aquele enganador, enquanto ainda vivia, disse: “Depois de três dias serei ressuscitado”.
verses.en_web: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’
verses.en_bbe: Saying, Sir, we have in mind how that false man said, while he was still living, After three days I will come again from the dead.

verses.en: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.
verses.pt: Portanto, manda que o sepulcro esteja em segurança até o terceiro dia, para que não aconteça dos seus discípulos virem de noite, e o furtem, e digam ao povo que ele ressuscitou dos mortos; e assim o último engano será pior que o primeiro.
verses.en_web: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He is risen from the dead;’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”
verses.en_bbe: Give orders, then, that the place where his body is may be made safe till the third day, for fear that his disciples come and take him away secretly and say to the people, He has come back from the dead: and the last error will be worse than the first.

verses.en: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.
verses.pt: Pilatos lhes disse: Vós tendes uma guarda. Ide fazer segurança como o entendeis.
verses.en_web: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”
verses.en_bbe: Pilate said to them, You have watchmen; go and make it as safe as you are able.

verses.en: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
verses.pt: E eles se foram, e fizeram segurança no sepulcro com a guarda, selando a pedra.
verses.en_web: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.
verses.en_bbe: So they went, and made safe the place where his body was, putting a stamp on the stone, and the watchmen were with them.
